notes: B-56 regression (fixed 2026-10-29). Twinblade Assassins: 'At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, draw a card.' Only a Treasure (noncreature) goes to the graveyard this turn (the zone and tokens expectations prove the sacrifice happened) -> NO draw expected: the hand stays at the setup draw's 1. Before the fix DIED_THIS_TURN counted every battlefield-to-graveyard dies row and the trigger drew. re-pinned 2026-10-30 (fixer 3): the runner now flags a pack-placed token record as a token (games.identity_of kept is_token), so a sacrificed Treasure ceases to exist (CR 704.5d, V35) instead of lying in the graveyard: its zone expectation is 'ceased' (was 'graveyard', which encoded the token-in-graveyard gap).
